name: Masked man
description: A tall, thin man in a bird-like mask wreathed in dark energy who greets Lukka in a cave of shell-backed creatures and offers him a deal.

timeline.summary: A masked man greets Lukka by name and offers to teach him in exchange for favors.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Arcavios, Lukka of Ikoria.
